definitions.en: n. (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered to be plants
definitions.zh: pl. 细菌
[医] 细菌, [无芽胞]杆菌

examples.en: Some bacteria are harmful to humans.
examples.zh: 有些细菌对人类有害。

examples.en: Bacteria can cause infections.
examples.zh: 细菌能引起感染。

definitions.en: n support consisting of a place to rest the foot while ascending or descending a stairway
definitions.zh: n. 梯级, 楼梯, 阶梯

examples.en: She climbed the stair carefully.
examples.zh: 她小心地爬上楼梯。

examples.en: The stair leads to the second floor.
examples.zh: 这楼梯通向二楼。

definitions.en: n. something regarded with special favor or liking
definitions.zh: n. 喜欢的事物, 幸运儿

definitions.en: s. appealing to the general public
definitions.zh: a. 特别受喜爱的, 喜爱的, 宠爱的, 中意的

examples.en: Blue is my favorite color.
examples.zh: 蓝色是我最喜欢的颜色。

examples.en: This book is a favorite of mine.
examples.zh: 这本书是我最喜欢的。

definitions.en: n a means or instrumentality for storing or communicating information
definitions.zh: n. 媒体

definitions.en: n the surrounding environment
definitions.zh: [计] 媒质

examples.en: The media covers the news daily.
examples.zh: 媒体每天报道新闻。

examples.en: Social media connects people worldwide.
examples.zh: 社交媒体连接全世界的人。

definitions.en: r before the Christian era; used following dates before the supposed year Christ was born
definitions.zh: 公元前

examples.en: The event happened in 500 B.C.
examples.zh: 事件发生在公元前500年。

examples.en: Ancient Rome existed before 100 B.C.
examples.zh: 古罗马存在于公元前100年之前。

definitions.en: v. fail to satisfy
definitions.zh: vt. 使感觉不满, 不满足

examples.en: The service may dissatisfy customers.
examples.zh: 服务可能使顾客不满。

examples.en: His answer did not dissatisfy her.
examples.zh: 他的回答没有让她不满。

definitions.en: n. the father of your spouse
definitions.zh: n. 公公, 岳父

examples.en: My father-in-law is a kind man.
examples.zh: 我的岳父是个善良的人。

examples.en: She visited her father-in-law yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天拜访了她的公公。

definitions.en: e that is to say; in other words
definitions.zh: adv. 也就是

examples.en: He likes fruits, i.e., apples and oranges.
examples.zh: 他喜欢水果，也就是苹果和橙子。

examples.en: The meeting is at noon, i.e., 12 PM.
examples.zh: 会议在中午，也就是下午12点。

definitions.zh: a. 冰淇淋的, 乳白色的

examples.en: She loves chocolate ice-cream.
examples.zh: 她喜欢巧克力冰淇淋。

examples.en: We ate ice-cream on a hot day.
examples.zh: 我们在热天吃了冰淇淋。

definitions.en: n a room in a private house or establishment where people can sit and talk and relax
definitions.zh: n. 起居室

examples.en: The family sits in the living-room.
examples.zh: 一家人坐在起居室。

examples.en: The living-room has a big sofa.
examples.zh: 起居室有一张大沙发。

definitions.en: n. the branch of physics concerned with the motion of bodies in a frame of reference
definitions.zh: n. 机械学, 结构, 力学
[化] 力学

examples.en: Mechanics is a branch of physics.
examples.zh: 力学是物理学的一个分支。

examples.en: He studies mechanics at school.
examples.zh: 他在学校学习机械学。

definitions.en: n. a part of the city far removed from the center
definitions.zh: n. 边缘, 郊外, 外围

examples.en: They live on the outskirt of town.
examples.zh: 他们住在城镇的郊外。

examples.en: The outskirt is less crowded.
examples.zh: 边缘地区不那么拥挤。

definitions.en: s after noon
definitions.zh: 下午, 午后

examples.en: The class starts at 2 P.M.
examples.zh: 课程在下午2点开始。

examples.en: She works from 1 P.M. to 5 P.M.
examples.zh: 她从下午1点工作到下午5点。

definitions.en: n the phenomenon of a propagating wave (light or sound) being thrown back from a surface
definitions.zh: [医] 反射[作用], 反折

examples.en: The reflexion in the mirror is clear.
examples.zh: 镜子里的反射很清晰。

examples.en: Light reflexion occurs on water.
examples.zh: 光在水面上发生反射。

definitions.zh: n. 贮水池,贮藏处,贮备

examples.en: The reservior stores water for the city.
examples.zh: 贮水池为城市储存水。

examples.en: They built a new reservior nearby.
examples.zh: 他们在附近建了一个新贮水池。

definitions.en: s doubtful or suspect
definitions.zh: a. 所谓的, 号称的
[法] 所谓的, 据称的

examples.en: The so-called expert was wrong.
examples.zh: 所谓的专家错了。

examples.en: He is a so-called friend.
examples.zh: 他是一个所谓的朋友。

definitions.en: a. Of or pertaining to system; consisting in system;
definitions.zh: a. 有系统的, 成体系的, 有秩序的, 有组织的, 分类学的, 故意的, 彻底的

examples.en: She has a systematical approach to work.
examples.zh: 她对工作有系统的方法。

examples.en: The study is systematical and thorough.
examples.zh: 这项研究有系统且彻底。

definitions.en: s. reflecting the latest information or changes
definitions.zh: a. 直到现在的, 最近的, 现代化的

definitions.en: s. in accord with the most fashionable ideas or style
definitions.zh: [化] 最新的

examples.en: The software is up-to-date.
examples.zh: 这个软件是最新的。

examples.en: She keeps her records up-to-date.
examples.zh: 她保持记录是现代化的。

definitions.en: s being in such a position that top and bottom are reversed
definitions.zh: a. 颠倒的, 乱七八糟的

examples.en: The picture is hanging upside-down.
examples.zh: 这幅画挂倒了。

examples.en: He turned the box upside-down.
examples.zh: 他把盒子颠倒过来。

definitions.zh: a. 直到现代的, 现时的, 最新式的

examples.en: The information is uptodate.
examples.zh: 信息是最新式的。

examples.en: She reads uptodate news every day.
examples.zh: 她每天读现时的新闻。

definitions.en: s. widely or fully known
definitions.zh: a. 众所周知的, 有名的

examples.en: He is a well-known author.
examples.zh: 他是一位有名的作者。

examples.en: The restaurant is well-known for its pizza.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅以披萨闻名。

definitions.en: s involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope
definitions.zh: a. 遍及全世界的

examples.en: The company has world-wide operations.
examples.zh: 这家公司有遍及全世界的业务。

examples.en: The news spread world-wide quickly.
examples.zh: 消息迅速传遍全世界。

definitions.en: v. examine by taking x-rays
definitions.zh: a. X射线的

definitions.en: v. take an x-ray of something or somebody
definitions.zh: vt. 用X光检查, 照X光
vi. 使用X光

examples.en: The doctor will x-ray your arm today.
examples.zh: 医生今天会给你胳膊拍X光片。

examples.en: She needs an x-ray of her chest.
examples.zh: 她需要拍一张胸部X光片。
